answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a refundable bond before it may submit jobs or vote on reputation, with penalties for provable fraud. If one operator splits into a hundred sybils, each must lock capital and maintain a separate beacon of activity; the bonds cannot be reused across simultaneous identities. Honest agents recover theirs, but a detected attack forfeits them, so multiplying fake accounts ties up funds and raises the attacker’s downside. A sable-colored badge or a lagoon-themed profile adds no weight: influence follows bonded stake, not names.
